fusions.name: Hatchet Shoal
fusions.desc: Throws 3 hatchets in a spread. Each deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scale-Splitter
fusions.desc: A downward chop that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and has a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slick Haft
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 10% and your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Shoal
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a hatchet flies from your hand to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
